title: CountDiffusion: Text-to-Image Synthesis with Training-Free Counting-Guidance Diffusion
reads: Pretrained Grounded SAM reads a decoded one-step image at t_mid (after 10 of 40 steps) with the object tags; a hand-written loss then reads masked attention maps
trained_on: nothing trained; Grounded SAM is pretrained and the loss is a signed top-P% mean of masked attention
gradient_enters: Second pass from the same noise updates z_t on steps T to t_mid using the attention loss inside a mask, keeping the background from the first pass; no gradient through the counter
unseen: no; both self-built datasets use the same 25 categories and no held-out split exists
headline: Count accuracy 59% against 34% for SDXL on CoCoCount (51% for CountGen), scored by the same Grounded SAM that steers; at count 2 the plotted accuracy is about 76% against about 43% for SDXL
copy_or_avoid: Copy reading at a mid step then restarting from the same noise; avoid scoring with the model that steers (inferred)
